header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: to bottom, among (beneath) banana trees whose clusters hang (layer upon layer), and in extended shade, and (beside) water made to flow (by Allah). They will be amid abundant kinds of fruit. (They will keep bearing fruit at all times; ever bearing,) never cut off; never forbidden (from being eaten). And (they will be) on raised couches (seated upon beds). Indeed We have created them (their wives) specially; and We have made them virgins, loving (towards their spouses) and of equal age. (All this) is for the people of the right; a multitude of the former ones and a multitude of the later ones (will be such people of the right).

blocks.text: (Explanation: 'The former ones' refers to the earlier communities, and 'the later ones' refers to this community).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَاتَشْتَهِي أَنْفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ ۞ نُزُلاً مِّنْ غَفُورٍرَّحِيمٍ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And therein (in that Jannah) you will have whatever your souls desire; and therein you will have whatever you ask for. (It will be) a hospitality from the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful (the angels will say).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَإِنَّ للِطّغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ ۞ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۚ فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ ۞ هذَا لا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌ ۞ وَّآخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ۞).
